values.note: Single site $15 a night; $5 per additional vehicle after two. recreation.gov's rate table has no 2026 season (closed).

values.note: Two paved loops (A and B) of 12 back-in sites each; 'Maximum size RV's permitted is 35 feet (in some sites only).'

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10168531 (notice: 'All sites are back-in only and can accommodate vehicles up to 35 feet. facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10168531 ('vault toilets, potable water, a Camp Host, and trash services') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/cabin-city-campground ('Vault toilets', 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites 1-6 in each loop are reservable on recreation.gov; sites 7-12 are first-come, first-served. Scan & Pay available with the Recreation.gov app.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/cabin-city-campground ('Sites 1-6 in Loops A and B are available for reservation on Recreation.gov. All other sites are first-come/first-served.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10168531 (notice 'The maximum stay limit is 16 days per reservation'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16), read 2026-10-22

note: Lolo NF (Superior RD) campground beside 12 Mile Creek, 2.5 mi off I-90 Exit 22 (Henderson) near St. Regis; paved, two loops, camp hosts, a short self-guided nature trail. Very limited cell reception. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (Superior RD); some sites reservable on recreation.gov, the rest FCFS. Confirmed the temporary closure (now manual, closure order to May 1, 2027), $15, 24 back-in non-electric sites to 35 ft, vault toilets, potable water, reservable/some_sites. Added water hookup none, season May 20 - Sept 17, 16-night limit, reopening. Not stated: booking window (inherited 180). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Temporarily closed: closed for the 2026 summer season after extensive storm damage; a Forest Service closure order covers the campground area, roads and trail May 11, 2026 - May 1, 2027 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/cabin-city-campground). Re-check in spring 2027.
